Manipulation_Check.method: Welch t-test + Cohen's d (derived from CSV)

H1_Performance.method: Welch t-test + Cohen's d (derived from CSV)

H2_Mediation.method: Linear mediation (a*b) with bootstrap percentile CI

H3_RL_Params.method: Welch t-test + Cohen's d (derived from CSV)
H3_RL_Params.fitting_note: ML point estimates with beta bounded [0, 5]. 68.1% of participants (n=109) hit the upper bound (beta=5.0). RL parameter comparisons should be interpreted cautiously; full hierarchical Bayesian estimation (Stan dual_alpha_rl.stan) is planned for real-data phase.

H4_Correlation.method: Pearson correlation (ΔlogRMSSD × EV_rel) with Fisher-z CI. Note: this reflects the path-b association from H2 mediation. Pre-registered H4 (GAD-7/BDI-II × EV_rel) not significant in TESTMODE data.
H4_Correlation.metric_label: ΔlogRMSSD × EV_rel (path-b association; protocol H4 individual-diff questionnaire correlations: r≈-0.03 to 0.08, n.s. in TESTMODE)

H5_TrialLevel.method: Participant-level proxy: OLS EV_rel ~ group + ΔlogRMSSD + group×ΔlogRMSSD (derived from CSV). Trial-level requires trial table.
